messages:
matt_ops: ap-ne1 is spiking — seeing node preemptions and a big queue build for mosaic-13b and redwood-multitask-7b. Queue depths: mosaic-13b ~1200, multitask-7b ~600. P50 latency doubled. :rotating_light:

ana_sre: @matt_ops can you paste eviction logs?

matt_ops: logs pasted below:
```
eviction: Preempted by provider (spot reclaim) node/gpu-03-apne terminated
pod/serve-mosaic-13b-7f8 Evicted: reason=NodePreempted status=Terminated
```

jun_infra: AP-NE spot churn is 3x baseline this morning. Autoscaler isn't keeping the cushion; replacements lagging ~6-7m. Suggest: offload non-enterprise traffic to dedicated-pool and turn on soft admission for ap-ne1.

zoe_ml: Can we fallback mosaic-13b -> mosaic-13b-q4 for non-tail requests? Quality hit is small and reduces memory/latency a lot.

matt_ops: Doing a quick mitigation stack: 1) enable soft admission (0.6) for ap-ne1 2) add model fallback mosaic-13b -> mosaic-13b-q4 3) route non-enterprise to us-west2 for new requests. Running commands now:
```
rkctl region set-admission ap-ne1 --soft-cap 0.6
rkctl model fallback add mosaic-13b -> mosaic-13b-q4 --region ap-ne1
rkctl route update /v1/generate --match 'customer.tier!=enterprise' --region=us-west2
```

deploy-bot: rollout/soft-admission-apne started by matt_ops — watch: https://ci.redwood/internal/build/8472 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana_sre: after soft-admission queue for mosaic-13b dropped to ~400. multitask-7b still heavy (~480). Looks like multitask-7b pods are getting placed on smaller spot pools; we should pin them to dedicated-pool-2.

jun_infra: I'll open a cloud ticket to request warm replacements and increase on-demand fallbacks. Also bumping autoscaler preempt threshold to reduce churn.

zoe_ml: TL;DR: fallback + soft admission gave immediate relief. I'll enable eval-runner to check q4 quality for the next hour and post any regressions.

matt_ops: Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/queue?region=ap-ne1 — keeping fallback for 3h and rate-limit in place until nodes stabilize. :eyes:

k8s-ops-bot: Pod eviction summary: 12 pods evicted in last 15m across 4 nodes. Node replacement ETA ~8m.

matt_ops: update: new nodes coming up, queue <150 across affected models. I'll revert the route override in 10m if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
